new_value: Landed the Python reference impl of the 8.13.1 local-fact credential model (commit c2e3033f34): new module python/src/lichen/gateway/local_facts.py with LocalFactClaims (all 7 spec claims, type+range validated, fail-closed on unknown claims), LocalFact (COSE_Sign1 envelope, alg -65537 pinned, kid=8-byte IID, 48-byte sig), issue_local_fact (gateway sign) and verify_local_fact (node verify), reusing cose_protected_header/cose_sig_structure/schnorr48 from delegation_tokens. Strict CBOR decode (_loads_strict rejects trailing bytes); isinstance-bstr guards; channel container-type validation; signature error contract. 27 tests, ruff+mypy clean. 3x codereview delegated to kimi-k3 (correctness/security/edge): correctness 5 findings (2 input-validation + docstring fixed in-diff; verify-over-wire-bytes + kid-binding deferred as beads lquv/rtnr), security 6 findings (channel TypeError fixed in-diff; bearer-credential/no-freshness/unbounded-tstr deferred as beads grna/b4fu/hytv), edge 3 findings (trailing-bytes + signature-TypeError fixed in-diff; wire-bytes dup of lquv). Scope note: this is the credential MODEL (claims/COSE sign/verify); the CoAP resource wiring (POST /.well-known/local-fact) and OSCORE transport are separate follow-on work not in this bead's landable slice.
